symptom: The single real Controller answer was blocked by a mismatch between advertised capabilities and executable broker handlers; a locally revised packet and adapter are unreviewed and no real Train catalog is admitted.
objective: Independently audit the exact revised Controller boundary and the separate data-admission dependency, integrate factual findings once, then obtain a read-only verdict on a single source snapshot before considering release or paid work.
boundary: Read-only audits of the canonical local checkout. Workers may write only their own dedicated log; no source edits, publication, paid GLM call, public fetch, data purchase, Train admission, Dev/Final access or budget mutation. The Supervisor owns integration and sole budget ledger.
resolution_check: One final reviewer checks the integrated evidence, source hash, capability honesty, data-role boundary, tests and canary; any P0 mismatch is REPLAN. This offline verdict cannot itself authorize release, provider execution or real-data admission.
